# Kailash OS Documentation {#docs-home}

This is the documentation for **Kailash OS** — a
NixOS-based Linux distribution for AI security work. It explains what
the system is, how it is built and governed, how to run it, and (as the
reference section lands) how to invoke every tool in its catalogue.

The distribution's main site is [kailash.site](https://kailash.site);
this site lives at `docs.kailash.tools`.

## How the documentation is organised

- **Part I — What is Kailash**: the system's purpose, the lab model it
  embodies, and the four-layer, 32-category taxonomy that organises its
  tool catalogue.
- **Part II — Security & governance**: how the distribution is built —
  declarative pins and locks, the safety classes that gate runnable
  tooling, and the release model that versions it.
- **Part III — Tool reference**: one man-style reference page per tool,
  generated from the tool manifest. *In build — see the coverage page
  for the delivery plan.*
- **Part IV — Administrator guide**: install, profile selection,
  updates, and regeneration of this guide itself.

## Status

The documentation is being built in the 2026.01 release window. Prose parts
land chapter by chapter; the per-tool reference section is generated
last, from the same manifest that drives the distribution's packaging.
Progress is tracked publicly on the repository's issue tracker.
